title: アレルギー表示とは (What allergen labelling is), as of April 2026
publisher: Consumer Affairs Agency, Government of Japan
reuse: The agency's terms of use say content may be freely used, copied, publicly transmitted, translated or otherwise modified, that commercial use is also permitted, and that the source must be cited. They say the terms are compatible with the Creative Commons Attribution License 4.0.
taken: The nine specified ingredients, for which labelling is mandatory, and the 20 items equivalent to them, for which it is recommended, by their Japanese names. The English names beside them are ours, checked against the agency's English leaflet, which still shows the older list of eight and 20. Ten recommended items were given no allergen fact: orange, kiwi fruit, beef, chicken, banana, pork, peach, yam, apple and gelatin.
